On top of this I was unable to get helpful customer support. I participated in multiple chat sessions and emails back and forth. It was frustrating because they could not answer my questions or give clear instructions or advice. I suspect I was not dealing with a human, in spite of the fact that I asked for that multiple times. In addition, speaking to a human on the phone is also not offered.
